LESSON: ISLAMIC RULES ON BUYING AND SELLING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.3: Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What should Muslims avoid while buying and selling?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. state the benefits of observing the Islamic rules on buying and selling
2. appreciate Islamic etiquette on the rules and regulations of buying and selling to earn rewards from Allah (Q83: 1-6)

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: state the benefits of observing the Islamic rules on buying and selling

Teach
• Today’s focus: state the benefits of observing the Islamic rules on buying and selling.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “state the benefits of observing the Islamic rules on buying and selling” using a school example.
• Model B for “state the benefits of observing the Islamic rules on buying and selling” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "state the benefits of observing the Islamic rules on buying and selling" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate Islamic etiquette on the rules and regulations of buying and selling to earn rewards from Allah (Q83: 1-6)

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate Islamic etiquette on the rules and regulations of buying and selling to earn rewards from Allah (Q83: 1-6).
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate Islamic etiquette on the rules and regulations of buying and selling to earn rewards from Allah (Q83: 1-6)” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate Islamic etiquette on the rules and regulations of buying and selling to earn rewards from Allah (Q83: 1-6)” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate Islamic etiquette on the rules and regulations of buying and selling to earn rewards from Allah (Q83: 1-6)" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: state the benefits of observing the Islamic rules on buying and selling
• Model 2: appreciate Islamic etiquette on the rules and regulations of buying and selling to earn rewards from Allah (Q83: 1-6)

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: state the benefits of observing the Islamic rules on buying and selling
2. Practise: appreciate Islamic etiquette on the rules and regulations of buying and selling to earn rewards from Allah (Q83: 1-6)

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What should Muslims avoid while buying and selling?
2. What are Islamic teachings on buying and selling?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• state the benefits of observing the Islamic rules on buying and selling
• appreciate Islamic etiquette on the rules and regulations of buying and selling to earn rewards from Allah (Q83: 1-6)

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
